name: valkey_fdw
abstract: PostgreSQL foreign data wrapper for Valkey
description: Maps Valkey keys onto SQL tables with typed, per-field columns. Strings, hashes, lists, sets and sorted sets; keyspace, keyprefix, keyset and singleton_key discovery; TLS with hostname verification, ACL authentication and cluster support. Writes are buffered and applied atomically by a single script at pre-commit, so a transaction that commits in PostgreSQL has been accepted by Valkey in full or not at all.
